title: Sentinel Manifest
description: Schema for sentinel-manifest.json produced by the manifest-generator agent. Describes frontend routes, backend endpoints, Pydantic schemas, CRUD flows, auth config, and risk policy for a target application.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the manifest was generated.

name.description: Application name derived from package.json, pyproject.toml, or directory name.

auth.description: Authentication configuration including login endpoint, roles, credentials, and role hierarchy.

loginEndpoint.description: Full path to the login endpoint (e.g. /api/v1/auth/login). Null if no login endpoint found.

roleHierarchy.description: Ordered list of roles from most access to least (e.g. ["admin", "manager", "user"]).

roles.description: Test credentials keyed by role name.

routes.description: Frontend routes extracted from the router file.

endpoints.description: Backend API endpoints extracted from endpoint files.

crudFlows.description: Detected CRUD lifecycle flows grouping related endpoints.

schemas.description: Pydantic model definitions keyed by class name.

breakpoints.description: Viewport widths in pixels for responsive testing.

riskLevel.description: Computed risk classification based on risk score thresholds: 0-25 safe, 26-50 medium, 51-75 high, 76-100 critical.

paramValue.description: Parameter resolution expression. Formats: lookup:<resource>[N].field, static:<value>, env:<VAR_NAME>.

path.description: Route path with {param} placeholders for dynamic segments.

requiredRole.description: Minimum role required to access this route. Null for public routes.

params.description: Parameter lookup expressions for dynamic segments. Null if no parameters.

description.description: Human-readable description. Populated for high/critical routes.

manual.description: True if this entry was manually added by the user and should be preserved during regeneration.

path.description: Full API path including version prefix and {param} placeholders.

requiredRole.description: Minimum role required. Null for public endpoints.

responseSchema.description: Name of the Pydantic response model class. Null if none specified.

description.description: Human-readable description from docstring or generated from function name.

sideEffects.description: List of side effect descriptions for high/critical endpoints (e.g. cascade deletes).

requiresConfirm.description: True if the endpoint requires a confirm query parameter.

params.description: Parameter lookup expressions for path parameters. Null if no parameters.

manual.description: True if this entry was manually added by the user and should be preserved during regeneration.

crudFlow.description: A CRUD lifecycle flow grouping related endpoints.

name.description: Flow name in the format {resource}-lifecycle (e.g. users-lifecycle).

steps.description: Ordered list of METHOD /path strings representing the CRUD operations.

manual.description: False for auto-generated flows, true for user-defined flows.

schemaDefinition.description: A Pydantic model definition with field metadata.

source.description: Source file and line number (e.g. user.py:15).

fields.description: Field definitions keyed by field name.

type.description: JSON-equivalent type of the Pydantic field.

required.description: True if the field has no default value.

nullable.description: True if the field accepts None/null.

note.description: Optional note about model complexity (e.g. extra fields allowed, computed fields).

schemaOverride.description: User-provided schema override preserved across regeneration.

riskPolicy.description: Risk policy controlling which actions are executed during sweeps.

maxRiskLevel.description: Maximum risk level that will be executed without sandbox approval.

alwaysSkip.description: List of METHOD /path patterns to always skip.

alwaysAllow.description: List of METHOD /path patterns to always allow regardless of risk level.
